text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...It's not going to be a walk in the park 
after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to be so disheartened. 
Had I attempted it, the outcome would 
undoubtedly have been the same."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure that with enough practice, 
you'll be able to win something like this 
eventually."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
